# Kivun legal pages

The terms of use and privacy policy for the Kivun (כיוון) app, in Hebrew and
English, served by GitHub Pages.

**These files are generated. Do not edit them here.** The source of truth is the
markdown in the app repository under `docs/launch/`, and the generator is
`docs/launch/legal/build.mjs`. Edit the markdown there, re-run the generator, and
copy the output here - otherwise the app's own copy and these pages drift apart,
and the app quotes the terms document verbatim in one place.
